method: Approved macOS single-window recording of the real native IDE
provider: Local deterministic model replay. Native tools, source checks, automatic review, file effects, persistence and rendering are real.

extraTakes.take01: Discarded because background webview timers slowed composer typing. No product tool ran.
extraTakes.take03: Excluded because the optional second-turn open_file failed with current-request validation. First take02 tools all succeeded.
extraTakes.take04: Excluded because the native window was no longer on screen. A verified visible window and capture-only focus calls fixed the result shot in take05.

limits: A scratch startup adapter invoked the unchanged native frontend and commands. This is not a released product binary.
The model messages are scripted input, not evidence of hosted model reasoning.
Edi did not run the sample tests. A separate native cargo test check passed both tests.
Native macOS recording badge appears in the titlebar while recording. The delivered edit may crop it.

diffVideo.story: The successful first-turn recorded diff, restored through normal native startup. No new agent operation.
